notablePrerequisites: There is at least one removable +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token plus at least one additional creature token due to Quina.
Activate Adaptive Gemguard by tapping two creature tokens, putting a +1/+1 counter on Adaptive Gemguard.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing a creature token, adding {R}.
Repeat.
